ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

appearances.note: Combine an appearance with a color. Appearances cover every emphasis level, from solid CTAs to low-weight ghost actions.

custom.note: Custom is not an arbitrary input. Define the custom color tokens in CSS.

button.description: Attribute directive that turns buttons and anchors into Solaris-themed buttons.

examples.note: Start with the default button, then explore appearances and variants below.

icons.note: Add icons before or after the label, or pick a brand icon for social login.

installation.note: Install the single Solaris package, then import the directive.

motion.note: Press uses a subtle 0.99 scale. Width, padding and gap animate, so loading, badge and label swaps grow smoothly instead of flicking.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

shape-radius.note: Radius controls corner rounding; wide shape elongates the button horizontally.

size-density.note: Size and density combine into a 3×3 matrix. The outer height always equals the control-height token of the combination.

button.title: Button
